progameguides.title: Recent games & guides
progameguides.name: Pro Game Guides
progameguides.desc: Recent Pro Game Guides coverage from the past 30 days, prioritizing new-game announcements, reviews and beginner guides, then other recent game guides. Up to 10 deduplicated articles, excluding code-only posts, hardware and unrelated content. Official RSS first, supplemented by labeled Google News aggregation. Article dates do not establish a game's launch date or measured popularity; updates to established games may be included.

ign.title: Recent picks & guides
ign.name: IGN Guides
ign.desc: Recent IGN game recommendations and guides from the past 30 days, with recommendations first, then guides. This is editorial coverage, not a measured popularity ranking. Uses official RSS where available, otherwise labeled Google News aggregation. Aggregated dates are reported by Google News and may differ from guide revision dates.

gamefaqs.title: Recent story walkthroughs
gamefaqs.name: GameFAQs
gamefaqs.desc: GameFAQs walkthroughs and main-story chapters dated within the past 30 days in Google News. Excludes side-quest, collectible and discussion entries. Links open the original coverage through Google News. Index dates do not verify the latest guide revision or game release date. Up to 10 available entries; older guides are not used to fill the list.

spotify.title: 7-day fastest risers
spotify.name: Spotify
spotify.desc: Ranks the latest published complete 7-day global weekly chart by position gain, limited to the public top 50 tracks. Each entry shows the chart dates and previous-to-current rank. New entries and reentries are excluded. This is not a rolling 7-day or streaming-growth chart.

amazon.title: Category best sellers
amazon.name: Amazon
amazon.desc: Public US Amazon category best sellers, showing category and actual category rank, not a sitewide chart. Falls back to labeled official updates if unavailable.

temu.title: Product categories
temu.name: Temu
temu.desc: Public Temu product category links, not a sales ranking. Falls back to labeled Temu company press releases if unavailable.

ebay.title: Auctions & refurbished
ebay.name: eBay
ebay.desc: Prioritizes public used collectible auctions, then labeled official refurbished recommendations and official updates. Refurbished recommendations are not an auction chart. Check product pages for current prices.

reddit.title: Popular discussions
reddit.name: Reddit
reddit.desc: Public Reddit r/popular RSS, showing popular discussions and their communities. Falls back to labeled official updates. This is not a personal subscription feed.

pinterest.title: 7-day image & text picks
pinterest.name: Pinterest
pinterest.desc: Public image Pins created within the past 7 days, discovered through Google News and verified on Pinterest. Aggregate saves rank first, then repins, then creation date. Aggregate saves are not this individual Pin's saves. Up to 10; not a sitewide weekly ranking or seven-day save growth. Pin dates can reflect a recent save of older artwork. Videos, sponsored Pins and unverified dates are omitted.

euronews.title: Latest news
euronews.name: Euronews
euronews.desc: Official Euronews news feed, with labeled news aggregation if unavailable.

lemonde.title: Latest news

youtube.title: 7-day popular videos
youtube.name: YouTube
youtube.desc: Recent video picks from YouTube's US English searches for music, gaming, entertainment, sports, science and technology, filtered to this week and sorted by public views. Up to 10 videos; not a sitewide chart or seven-day view growth. Rounded ages are checked conservatively.

instagram.title: 7-day video & photo picks
instagram.name: Instagram
instagram.desc: Public Reels and posts indexed by Google News within the past 7 days, ranked by visible cumulative likes from official Instagram embeds. Up to 10 recommendations; this is a sampled discovery list, not a sitewide weekly chart or seven-day like growth. Index dates do not verify original post dates. Unavailable or hidden-count posts are omitted.

facebook.title: 7-day video & photo picks
facebook.name: Facebook
facebook.desc: Public Facebook videos and posts indexed within 7 days by Google News. Videos with visible reactions rank first, then videos with views only, then recent post picks. Counts are cumulative and may be rounded. Up to 10; not a sitewide weekly ranking. Index dates do not verify original publication dates.

A sampled topic recommendation list, not X's official trending chart or seven-day like growth. Unavailable posts are omitted.

quora.title: 7-day topic picks
quora.name: Quora
quora.desc: Public Quora questions indexed by Google News within 7 days, with up to 10 recent topic recommendations. Index dates are not verified question creation dates. This feed has no engagement counts, so these are discovery picks, not an official Quora popularity ranking.
